links.title: ↺ Reset Filters to Default
links.tooltip: Clears all custom filters and restores default baseline values

list.name: region_filter
list.label: Geographic Region
list.query: All Regions : 1 = 1, North America : geo_region = 'north_america', Europe : geo_region = 'europe', Asia : geo_region = 'asia', Middle East : geo_region = 'middle_east', Latin America : geo_region = 'latin_america', Africa : geo_region = 'africa', Oceania : geo_region = 'oceania'

list.name: category_filter
list.label: Topic Category
list.query: All Categories : 1 = 1, Tech : category = 'tech', Entertainment : category = 'entertainment', Politics : category = 'politics', Finance : category = 'finance', Lifestyle : category = 'lifestyle', Other : category = 'other'

list.name: sentiment_filter
list.label: Sentiment
list.query: All Sentiments : 1 = 1, Positive : sentiment = 'positive', Neutral : sentiment = 'neutral', Negative : sentiment = 'negative'

list.name: top_hashtag
list.label: Trending Hashtags (Top 50)
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT hashtag FROM (SELECT hashtag, count(*) AS c FROM bluesky.enriched_posts ARRAY JOIN hashtags AS hashtag WHERE created_at >= now() - INTERVAL 2 HOUR AND hashtag != '' GROUP BY hashtag ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 50)
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT hashtag FROM (SELECT hashtag, count(*) AS c FROM bluesky.enriched_posts ARRAY JOIN hashtags AS hashtag WHERE created_at >= now() - INTERVAL 2 HOUR AND hashtag != '' GROUP BY hashtag ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 50)

list.name: bot_filter
list.label: Account Activity / Bot Filter
list.query: All Accounts : 1 = 1, Humans & Regular Posters (<= 15 posts/hr) : post_count <= 15, Casual Posters Only (<= 5 posts/hr) : post_count <= 5, Automated Feeds & Bots (> 15 posts/hr) : post_count > 15

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * sum(passed_sieve) / nullIf(sum(raw_received), 0), 1) FROM bluesky.funnel_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
SELECT round(avg(raw_rate), 1) FROM bluesky.funnel_stats WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 MINUTE

SELECT count(*) FROM bluesky.enriched_posts WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND is_breaking_claim >= 0.85 AND is_nsfw < 0.5 AND ${region_filter} AND ${category_filter} AND ${sentiment_filter} AND multiIf('$top_hashtag' = 'All' OR '$top_hashtag' = '', 1 = 1, has(hashtags, '$top_hashtag')) AND multiIf('$custom_hashtag' = '' OR '$custom_hashtag' = 'All', 1 = 1, has(hashtags, multiIf(startsWith('$custom_hashtag', '#'), '$custom_hashtag', concat('#', '$custom_hashtag'))) OR ilike(text, concat('%', '$custom_hashtag', '%')))

panels.title: Throughput Velocity: Raw Firehose vs. Sieve vs. Final Output (msgs/sec)

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 10 SECOND) AS time, round(avg(raw_rate), 1) AS "1. Raw Firehose (msgs/s)", round(avg(passed_rate), 1) AS "2. Sieve Passed to AI (msgs/s)" FROM bluesky.funnel_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(created_at, INTERVAL 10 SECOND) AS time, round(count(*) / 10.0, 1) AS "3. Final Output (Stored & Safe msgs/s)" FROM bluesky.enriched_posts WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND is_nsfw < 0.5 GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Pipeline Sieve Funnel: Stage-by-Stage Retention & Drop-Off

targets.rawSql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT '1. Raw Firehose Ingested' AS Stage, sum(raw_received) AS Volume, '100.0%' AS "Relative Share", 'Total raw events streamed from Bluesky WebSocket' AS "Pipeline Meaning" FROM bluesky.funnel_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) UNION ALL SELECT '2. Filtered: Replies & Threads', sum(dropped_replies), concat('-', toString(round(100.0 * sum(dropped_replies) / nullIf(sum(raw_received), 0), 1)), '%'), 'Dropped by Sieve (child replies / non-root threads)' FROM bluesky.funnel_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) UNION ALL SELECT '3. Filtered: Non-English', sum(dropped_non_en), concat('-', toString(round(100.0 * sum(dropped_non_en) / nullIf(sum(raw_received), 0), 1)), '%'), 'Dropped by Sieve (metadata language != en)' FROM bluesky.funnel_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) UNION ALL SELECT '4. Filtered: Obscene / Spam / NSFW', sum(dropped_spam_nsfw), concat('-', toString(round(100.0 * sum(dropped_spam_nsfw) / nullIf(sum(raw_received), 0), 1)), '%'), 'Dropped by Sieve (script mismatch, adult labels, spam domains)' FROM bluesky.funnel_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) UNION ALL SELECT '5. Passed Sieve to AI', sum(passed_sieve), concat(toString(round(100.0 * sum(passed_sieve) / nullIf(sum(raw_received), 0), 1)), '%'), 'Forwarded to Laya System One AI (100% - Replies - NonEn - Spam)' FROM bluesky.funnel_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) UNION ALL SELECT '6. Enriched in ClickHouse', count(*), '100% of Passed', 'Classified and indexed with sentiment, virality, geo, safety' FROM bluesky.enriched_posts WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) UNION ALL SELECT '7. Breaking Claims Alert', countIf(is_breaking_claim >= 0.85), concat(toString(round(100.0 * countIf(is_breaking_claim >= 0.85) / nullIf(count(*), 0), 2)), '%'), 'Escalated breaking news claims (conf >= 0.85)' FROM bluesky.enriched_posts WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)) ORDER BY Stage ASC

SELECT consumer AS "Worker / Consumer", argMax(backlog, timestamp) AS "Backlog (Waiting)", argMax(in_flight, timestamp) AS "In-Flight (Processing)", argMax(redelivered, timestamp) AS "Redeliveries", multiIf(argMax(redelivered, timestamp) > 50, 'STALLED / ERROR', argMax(backlog, timestamp) > 500, 'OVERWORKED', argMax(backlog, timestamp) > 50, 'MODERATE', 'HEALTHY') AS "Queue Health" FROM bluesky.queue_stats WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY consumer ORDER BY "Backlog (Waiting)" DESC

panels.title: Worker Backlog & Processing Lag Over Time (Messages Waiting)

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 10 SECOND) AS time, maxIf(backlog, consumer = 'inference_worker') AS "Inference Worker (AI GPU Queue)", maxIf(backlog, consumer = 'sink_worker') AS "Sink Worker (ClickHouse Batch Queue)", maxIf(backlog, consumer = 'escalation_worker') AS "Escalation Worker Queue" FROM bluesky.queue_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Top 10 Trending Hashtags (Drill Down via Region/Category)

targets.rawSql: SELECT arrayJoin(hashtags) AS hashtag, count(*) AS "Post Count" FROM bluesky.enriched_posts WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND hashtag != '' AND is_nsfw < 0.5 AND ${region_filter} AND ${category_filter} AND ${sentiment_filter} AND multiIf('$custom_hashtag' = '' OR '$custom_hashtag' = 'All', 1 = 1, has(hashtags, multiIf(startsWith('$custom_hashtag', '#'), '$custom_hashtag', concat('#', '$custom_hashtag'))) OR ilike(text, concat('%', '$custom_hashtag', '%'))) GROUP BY hashtag ORDER BY "Post Count" DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Sentiment Breakdown per Top 10 Hashtags (100% Stacked)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  hashtag,
  round(100.0 * countIf(sentiment = 'positive') / nullIf(count(*), 0), 1) AS Positive,
  round(100.0 * countIf(sentiment = 'neutral') / nullIf(count(*), 0), 1) AS Neutral,
  round(100.0 * countIf(sentiment = 'negative') / nullIf(count(*), 0), 1) AS Negative
FROM (
  SELECT arrayJoin(hashtags) AS hashtag, sentiment
  FROM bluesky.enriched_posts
  WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND hashtag != '' AND is_nsfw < 0.5 AND ${region_filter} AND ${category_filter}
    AND hashtag IN (
      SELECT arrayJoin(hashtags) AS h
      FROM bluesky.enriched_posts
      WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND h != '' AND is_nsfw < 0.5 AND ${region_filter} AND ${category_filter}
      GROUP BY h
      ORDER BY count(*) DESC
      LIMIT 10
    )
)
GROUP BY hashtag
ORDER BY (countIf(sentiment = 'positive') + countIf(sentiment = 'neutral') + countIf(sentiment = 'negative')) DESC

SELECT arrayJoin(hashtags) AS hashtag, round(avg(virality), 2) AS avg_virality, count(*) AS sample_posts FROM bluesky.enriched_posts WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND hashtag != '' AND is_nsfw < 0.5 AND ${region_filter} AND ${category_filter} AND ${sentiment_filter} AND multiIf('$custom_hashtag' = '' OR '$custom_hashtag' = 'All', 1 = 1, has(hashtags, multiIf(startsWith('$custom_hashtag', '#'), '$custom_hashtag', concat('#', '$custom_hashtag'))) OR ilike(text, concat('%', '$custom_hashtag', '%'))) GROUP BY hashtag HAVING sample_posts >= 2 ORDER BY avg_virality DESC, sample_posts DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Most Active Posters (Filtered by Activity Tier)
panels.description: Displays authors ranked by post volume. Controlled by the 'Account Activity / Bot Filter' dropdown at top.

targets.rawSql: SELECT author_did, count(*) AS post_count, round(avg(virality), 2) AS avg_virality, topK(1)(category)[1] AS dominant_category FROM bluesky.enriched_posts WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND is_nsfw < 0.5 AND ${region_filter} AND ${category_filter} AND ${sentiment_filter} AND multiIf('$top_hashtag' = 'All' OR '$top_hashtag' = '', 1 = 1, has(hashtags, '$top_hashtag')) AND multiIf('$custom_hashtag' = '' OR '$custom_hashtag' = 'All', 1 = 1, has(hashtags, multiIf(startsWith('$custom_hashtag', '#'), '$custom_hashtag', concat('#', '$custom_hashtag'))) OR ilike(text, concat('%', '$custom_hashtag', '%'))) GROUP BY author_did HAVING ${bot_filter} ORDER BY post_count DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT geo_region AS region, count(*) AS "Mention Count" FROM bluesky.enriched_posts WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND geo_region != 'global_none' AND is_nsfw < 0.5 GROUP BY region ORDER BY "Mention Count" DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT category, count(*) AS count FROM bluesky.enriched_posts WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND category != 'unknown' AND is_nsfw < 0.5 AND ${region_filter} AND ${sentiment_filter} AND multiIf('$top_hashtag' = 'All' OR '$top_hashtag' = '', 1 = 1, has(hashtags, '$top_hashtag')) AND multiIf('$custom_hashtag' = '' OR '$custom_hashtag' = 'All', 1 = 1, has(hashtags, multiIf(startsWith('$custom_hashtag', '#'), '$custom_hashtag', concat('#', '$custom_hashtag'))) OR ilike(text, concat('%', '$custom_hashtag', '%'))) GROUP BY category ORDER BY count DESC

panels.title: Posts by Category (Live Curves by Category)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(created_at, INTERVAL 15 SECOND) AS time,
  countIf(category = 'tech') AS Tech,
  countIf(category = 'entertainment') AS Entertainment,
  countIf(category = 'politics') AS Politics,
  countIf(category = 'finance') AS Finance,
  countIf(category = 'lifestyle') AS Lifestyle,
  countIf(category = 'other') AS Other
FROM bluesky.enriched_posts
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND is_nsfw < 0.5 AND ${region_filter} AND ${sentiment_filter} AND multiIf('$top_hashtag' = 'All' OR '$top_hashtag' = '', 1 = 1, has(hashtags, '$top_hashtag')) AND multiIf('$custom_hashtag' = '' OR '$custom_hashtag' = 'All', 1 = 1, has(hashtags, multiIf(startsWith('$custom_hashtag', '#'), '$custom_hashtag', concat('#', '$custom_hashtag'))) OR ilike(text, concat('%', '$custom_hashtag', '%')))
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT toString(created_at) AS timestamp, category, geo_region, round(is_breaking_claim, 2) AS breaking_conf, round(virality, 2) AS virality, text FROM bluesky.enriched_posts WHERE is_breaking_claim >= 0.85 AND is_nsfw < 0.5 AND ${region_filter} AND ${category_filter} AND ${sentiment_filter} AND multiIf('$top_hashtag' = 'All' OR '$top_hashtag' = '', 1 = 1, has(hashtags, '$top_hashtag')) AND multiIf('$custom_hashtag' = '' OR '$custom_hashtag' = 'All', 1 = 1, has(hashtags, multiIf(startsWith('$custom_hashtag', '#'), '$custom_hashtag', concat('#', '$custom_hashtag'))) OR ilike(text, concat('%', '$custom_hashtag', '%'))) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT cashtag, count(*) AS mentions FROM bluesky.enriched_posts ARRAY JOIN cashtags AS cashtag WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND is_nsfw < 0.5 AND ${region_filter} AND multiIf('${category_filter}' LIKE '%finance%' OR '${category_filter}' LIKE '%tech%', ${category_filter}, 1 = 1) AND ${sentiment_filter} AND multiIf('$top_hashtag' = 'All' OR '$top_hashtag' = '', 1 = 1, has(hashtags, '$top_hashtag')) AND multiIf('$custom_hashtag' = '' OR '$custom_hashtag' = 'All', 1 = 1, has(hashtags, multiIf(startsWith('$custom_hashtag', '#'), '$custom_hashtag', concat('#', '$custom_hashtag'))) OR ilike(text, concat('%', '$custom_hashtag', '%'))) GROUP BY cashtag ORDER BY mentions DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT word, count(*) AS freq FROM bluesky.enriched_posts ARRAY JOIN arrayFilter(w -> length(w) >= 3 AND match(w, '^[a-z]+$') AND w NOT IN ('the', 'and', 'for', 'that', 'this', 'with', 'from', 'have', 'has', 'had', 'just', 'like', 'about', 'what', 'when', 'your', 'they', 'them', 'their', 'will', 'some', 'been', 'there', 'more', 'would', 'which', 'https', 'http', 'com', 'www', 'bsky', 'app', 'social', 'you', 'are', 'was', 'were', 'all', 'can', 'could', 'not', 'out', 'one', 'who', 'his', 'her', 'him', 'how', 'get', 'got', 'now', 'but', 'into', 'also', 'than', 'then', 'any', 'other', 'see', 'our', 'its', 'way', 'make', 'even', 'only', 'after', 'over', 'back', 'well', 'did', 'does', 'too'), tokens(lower(text))) AS word WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND is_nsfw < 0.5 AND ${region_filter} AND ${category_filter} AND ${sentiment_filter} AND multiIf('$top_hashtag' = 'All' OR '$top_hashtag' = '', 1 = 1, has(hashtags, '$top_hashtag')) AND multiIf('$custom_hashtag' = '' OR '$custom_hashtag' = 'All', 1 = 1, has(hashtags, multiIf(startsWith('$custom_hashtag', '#'), '$custom_hashtag', concat('#', '$custom_hashtag'))) OR ilike(text, concat('%', '$custom_hashtag', '%'))) GROUP BY word ORDER BY freq DESC LIMIT 50
